lines.x: No problem, Doctor. I've got your back.
How do I aim while I'm skatin'? It's a piece'a cake, no sweat. Wanna see? C'mere, put your hand on mine.

Back in the day, me and my friends thought it was sick as hell to be different. But once I got infected, I found out that wasn't cool at all. You don't let a little Originium dust run your life, you gotta grab the wheel n' steer.
An old cop taught me how to shoot a crossbow, n' his daughter threw in skateboardin' lessons. How'd I put 'em together? Pure street genius—straight up self-taught.
Don't get it twisted, skateboardin's just one of my jams... It's the first way I ever really found myself. But the good stuff comes after that. Wanna hear the whole story?

Why'd I wanna be a combat operator...? Doc, lemme ask you: what's the one thing us rowdy street kids really live for? Freedom, straight up. I'm cool to throw down for freedom, an' that's why I'm with Rhodes Island.

I'm real broken up about bein' Infected, y'know? Like that park mural I was sprayin'—left that one half-done. And I'm never gonna get those secret-recipe onion rings from that old cop again. Huh? That's all.

I came to Rhodes Island to get some help with this disease. Thought it'd be some sterile place that reeked of disinfectant, everyone all shut up in their rooms... But man was I surprised. Even though you don't allow tagging inside the cabins, that Ethan guy... Y'know what, never mind.

I figured out how to express myself with donut hamburger combos, skateboarding, and rap battles. What's your deal, Doctor? If you're feelin' burnt out, come kick it with me and Vigna. We'll... hang out. Hanging out is in our DNA. Gotta respect that.
If you're tired, just go rest. I'll be here.
Aciddrop, Operator. This skateboard's a registered piece of equipment, got it? Any issues, just hit me up.
Damn, that's cool.
A promotion, huh? Thanks. Tryin' to remember the last time somethin' like this went down. Gotta be after I won the Crab Cup…
The old man taught me to use a crossbow just so I could protect myself from the streets. Who woulda thought I'd end up usin' it to defend the freedom of the Infected.
You got it.
Teamwork's an important part of scoring too.
Let's roll.
Enemy sighted.
I'm right here.
C'mon, how should I deal with these guys?
Now I'm all pumped up.
Some sweet terrain to ride.
Ollie!
Time to show off a bit.
I'm over here.
Kickflip, then kick ass.
Good work out there, Doctor... Oh, could you help me swap a couple of bolts when we get back?
That moment you clear a challenge always gets me all hyped up.
Should we chase after 'em? If you ask me, I can still catch up.
Ugh... Can't believe this amateur wipeout...
This looks perfect for a throw… Uh, I didn't say nothin'.
Wahh!
Wanna head to the canteen together? If I nail this trip without any wipeouts, promise you'll treat me to some juice.
Arknights.
Oh, Doctor, Happy New Year! We've got a block party in a bit. Why don't you come show off your moves? You could give breakdancin' a shot? It ain't that hard, I'll teach ya!
Hey, Doctor.

You're still working? Let's go get some exercise outside. Wait, you volunteered for overtime? Doctor, ain't no point in workin' this much. Life only begins once you clock out! C'mon, what do you wanna eat? It's on me.

I used to skate to ditch class n' get away from the adults. Then, it was to lose the cops when I was out tagging. I said I did it in the name of freedom, but thinkin' back, I guess that was kinda selfish. We fight harder for other people's freedom than our own, don'tcha think? Like what we're doin' here.
